question: Does declaring spatial support change the study's verdict?
what_changed: only the covariates: CHELSA sampled at each cell's centre pixel (study) vs the area-weighted mean over the whole cell (healpix-connector). Same records, same cells, same model, same seed.
determinism: the analysis is seeded; repeating the baseline reproduced 96.67 / 97.24 exactly, so the differences below are attributable to the covariates

verdict.study_verdict: Contradicted (target-group background does not restore hotspot identity)

caveats: museum strategy only; the all-observations download is 7 GB and was not run
one depth (nside 256); the study's full ladder was not rerun
our baseline gives 96.67 where the study published 97.24, a reproduction difference of 0.57 pp from data vintage and environment, of the same size as the effect measured here
